Prove the real-linear sphere-image convexity that is the crux of the 2x2 Toeplitz--Hausdorff core: for every real-linear continuous F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) -> ℂ the image of the unit sphere is ℝ-convex. Distinct scope: pure real-linear algebra in dimension 3; it mentions no numericalRange, no matrix entries and no Bloch-angle parametrisation, so it is disjoint from the in-flight monolithic attempt research_1_numrange_convex_fin2 (researcher-2) except as a reusable input. Concrete first construction: get 0 != k with F k = 0 because ker F != bot (else F is injective and 3 = finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) <= finrank ℝ ℂ = 2, via LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective and Submodule.ne_bot_iff). Then for n with ‖n‖ <= 1 the function t |-> ‖n + t • k‖ is continuous, is ‖n‖ <= 1 at t = 0, and exceeds 1 for large t >= 0 (‖n + t • k‖ >= t ‖k‖ - ‖n‖); intermediate_value_Icc gives t with ‖n + t • k‖ = 1, and F (n + t • k) = F n. Hence F '' {x | ‖x‖ = 1} = F '' Metric.closedBall 0 1, and the right-hand set is ℝ-convex as the linear image of a convex set. Intended consumer: the OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.numericalRange_convex_fin2 assembly, where numericalRange M equals tr M / 2 + F '' {x | ‖x‖ = 1} for the real-linear F built from the traceless part of M. No dependsOn edge is added because that task is running; this lemma is claimable independently and gets wired in only if the monolithic attempt returns unproved, at which point a parametrisation lemma is added and numericalRange_convex is rewired to depend on both.
